podcast.title: Influence on Matt Helders' Drumming
podcast.body: The D4, specifically the style of their drummer Daniel Pooley, combined with Matt Helders' early exposure to dance and hip hop, is cited as an explanation for Matt Helders' distinctive drumming style in the Arctic Monkeys.
